growth.choice.current-state.native-verif: The frontier accepts the current state only through its exact native rebuild verifier.
growth.choice.human-route-coverage.nativ: The frontier accepts route coverage only through its exact native rebuild verifier.
growth.choice.portfolio.crossbind: Current state, exact coverage, and catalog are bound to one ten-outcome, six-chain portfolio.

growth.choice.catalog.digest-verify: The catalog self-digest is rebuilt exactly.
growth.choice.catalog.semantic-crossbind: Every ready and held catalog row cross-binds exact coverage claims, references, and states.
growth.choice.catalog.command-boundary: Commands must share one bounded workspace-relative JavaScript runner and exact capability selector; held routes stay commandless.

human.choice.no-default: The current menu has no default route.
human.choice.no-ranking: The current menu has no ranking or recommendation.
human.choice.no-preselection: Every ready route is unselected and unstarted.
human.choice.wait-or-opt-out: Waiting and opting out remain explicit, penalty-free choices; menu or prompt requires a new human request.

human.choice.held-route.commandless: The held signal-lineage route remains visible but has no command.
human.choice.held-route.external-event: The held route retains its exact reason, proposal, and required external event.

growth.choice.beneficiary-separation: Technical, AI-workflow, and human evidence counts remain separate.
growth.choice.technical-ahead-visible: The frontier explicitly reports that technical evidence is ahead while shared AI-and-human growth remains unestablished.

authority.choice-frontier.none: The frontier grants no selection, prompt, review, execution, lifecycle, Foundation, training, or CANON authority.
side-effect.choice-frontier.none: The pure leaf has zero permissions, reads, writes, or network effects.

human.choice.selection.live: No person has explicitly requested, selected, started, completed, or withdrawn from a current route.

growth.human-evidence.live: All six current human claims remain NOT_RUN.

human.source.authentication: Local pseudonymous references do not authenticate identity or human presence.
